inlines.v: PERT, adjective 1. Lively; brisk; smart. Awake the pert and nimble spirit of mirth. On the lawny sands and shelves, Trip the pert fairies, and the dapper elves. 2. Forward; saucy; bold; indecorously free. A lady bids me in a very pert manner mind my own affairs--
